ns0:text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

ns0:g.ns0:text: The curve-number model predicts runoff depth only after initial abstraction is exceeded

ns0:text.ns0:tspan: Traditional NRCS/SCS event-depth model with explicitly chosen λ=I
/S=0.20 and S=25400/CN−254 in millimetres. CN reflects the specified

ns0:g.ns0:text: watershed/antecedent condition; it is not a universal material constant. Other initial-abstraction conventions require compatible calibration. Runoff
depth does not give peak flow or timing without an additional response model.
